subject: RM_Peeper
label: peeper
description: A once-predator gone soft and eye-studded — extra eyes opened in its hide until watching replaced hunting. A docile mid-tier browser of the goo margins, and another sky-reader the patient can learn from.
departures: many extra eyes open across the hide: back, flanks and limbs, not only on the head
eyes on the back face upward, looking at the sky
predator build gone soft: a slack, rounded body instead of a lean hunting body
blunted, dull fangs and claws left over from its predator past
